oneOf.description: Dynamic Adaptive Streaming over HTTP — an ISO-standard segmented visual streaming protocol for adaptive video delivery.
HTTP Live Streaming — Apple’s segmented streaming protocol used for visual content delivery across web and mobile platforms.
MPEG-2 Transport Stream — an ISO/IEC format for packetized video/audio transport widely used in broadcasting and IPTV.
Network Device Interface — a low‑latency IP-based visual transport protocol used in production environments.
Serial Digital Interface — a professional broadcast standard carrying uncompressed digital video over coaxial or fiber links.
SMPTE ST 2110 — a broadcast suite enabling essence‑based IP transport of video, audio, and metadata for professional workflows.
Ancillary Time Code (LTC variant) — packet-based SMPTE timecode embedded in HD‑SDI and IP streams for frame-accurate video synchronization.
Ancillary Time Code (VITC variant) — SMPTE timecode carried as ancillary packets inside HD‑SDI/IP streams, used for synchronized visual playback.
Real-time Transport Protocol — a foundational transport protocol for real‑time visual media streaming over IP networks.
Web Real-Time Communication — a real‑time, peer‑to‑peer streaming mechanism used for interactive visual communication.
